thread:
maya: Heads-up: bringing up aurora-lite-12b (int4) on canary. We're seeing intermittent OOMs on long generations (>512). Pattern looks tied to batch size + KV churn, not a deterministic failure.

zach: Which runtime/kernel and can you drop the raw error?

maya: runtime: inference-rt v2.3.1 (gpu-2026-03 build). Log: ```
E OOM allocator: couldn't allocate 320MB for token_buffer
E kv_cache: evicting slots=2, reason=slab_pressure
E slab_jitter=0.59
E trace: batch=2147 seq_in=600 max_new=1024
```

ida: That slab_jitter number rings a bell. We fixed a similar spike on argo by increasing slot_reserve from 0.05 -> 0.12 and enabling soft-evict.

ben: Also confirm tokenization: aurora-lite tends to produce long system+example prefixes for docs-demo flows. Any real traffic numbers?

maya: Convo-bench shows ~9% of requests exceed 512 tokens for docs-summarize. Canary is representative.

zach: Proposed repro + mitigation plan: 1) replay mixed traffic locally (ratio: 80% <128, 12% 128-512, 8% >512) 2) try slot_reserve=0.14 + soft_evict=true 3) temp default max_new_tokens=256 for canary 4) enable small_batch_fallback so very large gens are isolated.

ida: Add a KV-prefetch_grace_ms (80ms) to avoid eager prefetch on seq_len spikes. That helped reduce eviction cascades before.

ben: Agree on small_batch_fallback. It sacrifices some throughput but prevents OOM ripples across the canary pool.

maya: Pushed canary config patch: ```yaml
model: aurora-lite-12b-int4
defaults:
  max_new_tokens: 256
  slot_reserve: 0.14
  soft_evict: true
  small_batch_fallback: true
  kv_prefetch_grace_ms: 80
```

infra-bot: deploy-bot: queued canary config change set 5483 for aurora-lite-12b-int4; applying to canary pool in ~2min.

maya: Starting synthetic replay now.

zach: If stable, add onboarding checklist updates: - run convo-bench distribution check - conservative max_new_tokens default for int4 variants - run slab_jitter diagnostic during canary.

maya: First 15m after change: zero OOMs, eviction rate down ~68%, slab_jitter fell to 0.17. Still occasional +150ms tail latency on >512 but acceptable.

ida: Nice. Grab a couple of heap/KV profiles and attach to the model ticket for future quant/rollout docs.

maya: Done. Uploaded GPU traces and canary logs. My proposal: ship conservative defaults (max_new_tokens=256, slot_reserve=0.12) and add an "isolation" opt-in so customers can request higher max_new when willing to take capacity isolation.

ben: Also add a short note in release notes about int4 long-horizon tradeoffs; suggest int8 for heavy long-gen customers.

zach: Good work. We'll watch metrics for 24h then consider prod-default rollout.

monitor-bot: alerts: updated rule aurora-lite-12b slab_jitter > 0.4 -> page @eng-ml.

maya: Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
